title: System Log Formatter
spec: Create a module to format system logs. Write 8 formatting functions: `format_auth_log(timestamp, user, status)`, `format_db_log(timestamp, query, duration_ms)`, `format_req_log(timestamp, method, path, ip)`, `format_err_log(timestamp, code, trace)`, `format_debug_log(timestamp, module, msg)`, `format_warn_log(timestamp, component, msg)`, `format_audit_log(timestamp, user, action)`, and `format_sys_log(timestamp, service, msg)`. Each function must return its arguments joined by a pipe character '|'. Include a driver `main()` function that calls each formatting function with dummy string arguments and prints the results.

title: HL7 Health Message Segment Builder
spec: Implement a script to build basic HL7 health data segments. Write 8 functions: `build_msh(sender, receiver, msg_id)`, `build_pid(pat_id, first_name, last_name)`, `build_obr(order_id, test_code, date)`, `build_obx(obs_id, value, units, ref_range)`, `build_al1(allergy_type, allergen, severity)`, `build_dg1(diag_code, description, type_str)`, `build_evn(event_type, date, reason)`, and `build_nte(source, comment, type_str)`. Each function must return a list of its parts (starting with the 3-letter segment type, followed by its arguments in order) joined by the pipe character '|'. Provide a `main()` that creates and prints one of each segment.

title: Simple SQL Query Generator
spec: Write a module to generate raw SQL strings. Implement 8 functions: `build_select(table, columns)` which returns `['SELECT', columns, 'FROM', table]` joined by a space ' '. Implement `build_insert(table, values)` returning `['INSERT INTO', table, 'VALUES', values]` joined by a space. Implement `build_update(table, assignments, condition)` returning `['UPDATE', table, 'SET', assignments, 'WHERE', condition]` joined by a space. Implement `build_delete(table, condition)` returning `['DELETE FROM', table, 'WHERE', condition]` joined by a space. Implement `build_create(table, definitions)` returning `['CREATE TABLE', table, definitions]` joined by a space. Implement `build_drop(table)` returning `['DROP TABLE', table]` joined by a space. Implement `build_alter(table, action)` returning `['ALTER TABLE', table, action]` joined by a space. Implement `build_truncate(table)` returning `['TRUNCATE TABLE', table]` joined by a space. Write a `main()` function demonstrating all eight generators.

title: Regex Pattern Assembler
spec: Create a library to assemble common regex patterns from user-provided sub-patterns. Write 8 functions: `match_email(user_pat, domain_pat)` returning the two patterns joined by '@'. Write `match_url_simple(proto, host)` returning them joined by '://'. Write `match_phone(country, area, local)` returning the three parts joined by '-'. Write `match_ipv4(oct1, oct2, oct3, oct4)` returning the four parts joined by '\.'. Write `match_date(year, month, day)` returning the three parts joined by '-'. Write `match_time(hour, minute, second)` returning the three parts joined by ':'. Write `match_datetime(date_pat, time_pat)` returning them joined by 'T'. Write `match_mac(b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6)` returning the six parts joined by ':'. Include a `main()` that calls each function with string literal patterns.

title: Global Name Formatter
spec: Implement a module to format names according to different conventions. Write 8 formatting functions: `western_name(first, middle, last)` returning them joined by a space ' '. Write `eastern_name(last, first)` returning them joined by a space. Write `directory_name(last, first_middle)` returning the last name and the first_middle name joined by ', '. Write `initials(first_init, middle_init, last_init)` returning them joined by a dot '.'. Write `formal_name(title, first, last)` returning them joined by a space. Write `mononym(name, title)` returning them joined by a space. Write `hyphenated_last(last1, last2)` returning them joined by '-'. Write `account_name(last, id_str)` returning them joined by '_'. Provide a `main()` function demonstrating each formatting style with sample strings.

title: Virtual Filesystem Path Builder
spec: Create a script to build paths for a custom virtual filesystem. Write 8 functions: `root_path(volume, folder)` returning them joined by ':/'. Write `user_path(home_dir, username)` returning them joined by '/'. Write `config_path(user_dir, app_name)` returning the user dir, '.config', and app name joined by '/'. Write `cache_path(user_dir, app_name)` returning the user dir, '.cache', and app name joined by '/'. Write `log_path(user_dir, app_name)` returning the user dir, '.local', 'log', and app name joined by '/'. Write `temp_path(sys_temp, app_name)` returning them joined by '/'. Write `backup_path(user_dir, app_name, date_str)` returning them joined by '/'. Write `plugin_path(app_path, plugin_name)` returning them joined by '/'. Provide a `main()` that generates and prints each type of path.

title: Email MIME Header Generator
spec: Write a module to construct raw email headers. Implement 8 functions: `build_address(name, email_in_brackets)` returning them joined by a space ' '. Implement `build_received(host, ip_in_brackets)` returning `['from', host, ip_in_brackets]` joined by a space. Implement `build_content_type(mime_type, charset_str)` returning them joined by '; '. Implement `build_disposition(disposition, filename_str)` returning them joined by '; '. Implement `build_auth_results(server, dkim_str)` returning them joined by '; '. Implement `build_message_id(local, domain)` returning them joined by '@'. Implement `build_cc(addr1, addr2, addr3)` returning them joined by ', '. Implement `build_in_reply_to(id1, id2)` returning them joined by a space ' '. Include a `main()` block to run all 8 functions with test strings.

title: Graphviz DOT Statement Generator
spec: Implement a tool to generate Graphviz DOT format statements. Write 8 functions: `directed_edge(node1, node2)` returning them joined by ' -> '. Write `undirected_edge(node1, node2)` returning them joined by ' -- '. Write `node_label(node, label_str)` returning them joined by ' = '. Write `subgraph_decl(name, content_str)` returning `['subgraph', name, '{', content_str, '}']` joined by a space ' '. Write `graph_attr(attr, value_str)` returning them joined by '='. Write `node_style(node, style)` returning `[node, '[style=', style, ']']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `edge_color(n1, n2, color)` returning `[n1, '->', n2, '[color=', color, ']']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `strict_graph(name, content)` returning `['strict graph', name, '{', content, '}']` joined by a space ' '. Provide a `main()` testing each function.

title: Docker CLI Command Builder
spec: Create a script to generate Docker CLI commands. Write 8 functions: `port_mapping(host_port, container_port)` returning them joined by ':'. Write `volume_mapping(host_dir, container_dir)` returning them joined by ':'. Write `env_var(key, value)` returning them joined by '='. Write `image_tag(image_name, tag)` returning them joined by ':'. Write `run_cmd(options, image, command)` returning the sequence `['docker run', options, image, command]` joined by a space ' '. Write `build_cmd(tag, path)` returning `['docker build', '-t', tag, path]` joined by a space ' '. Write `exec_cmd(container, command)` returning `['docker exec', '-it', container, command]` joined by a space. Write `network_alias(net, alias)` returning `['--network', net, '--network-alias', alias]` joined by a space. Include a `main()` that uses these functions.

title: Semantic Version String Builder
spec: Write a module for constructing Semantic Versioning (SemVer) strings. Implement 8 functions: `build_core(major, minor, patch)` returning the three parts joined by '.'. Implement `build_prerelease(core_version, pre_id)` returning them joined by '-'. Implement `build_build(version, build_meta)` returning them joined by '+'. Implement `build_dependency(package, version)` returning them joined by '@'. Implement `build_range(version1, version2)` returning them joined by ' - '. Implement `build_caret(package, version)` returning `['^', package, '@', version]` joined by an empty string ''. Implement `build_tilde(package, version)` returning `['~', package, '@', version]` joined by an empty string ''. Implement `build_or(range1, range2)` returning the two ranges joined by ' || '. Write a `main()` function testing all builders.

title: Simple CSS Rule Generator
spec: Implement a generator for inline CSS strings. Write 8 functions: `css_class(name, rules)` returning the sequence `['.', name, ' { ', rules, ' }']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `css_id(name, rules)` returning `['#', name, ' { ', rules, ' }']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `css_prop(property, value)` returning them joined by ': '. Write `css_important(value)` returning `[value, '!important']` joined by a space ' '. Write `css_media_query(condition, rules)` returning `['@media', condition, '{', rules, '}']` joined by a space ' '. Write `css_pseudo(selector, pseudo)` returning them joined by ':'. Write `css_child(parent, child)` returning them joined by ' > '. Write `css_sibling(el1, el2)` returning them joined by ' + '. Add a `main()` function testing all generators.

title: Publication Code Formatter
spec: Create a script to format various publication identification codes. Write 8 functions: `format_isbn13(prefix, group, publisher, title, check)` returning the 5 parts joined by '-'. Write `format_isbn10(group, publisher, title, check)` returning the 4 parts joined by '-'. Write `format_issn(part1, part2)` returning the 2 parts joined by '-'. Write `format_doi(prefix, suffix)` returning the 2 parts joined by '/'. Write `format_sici(issn, chron, enum)` returning the 3 parts joined by '-'. Write `format_upc(mfr, product, check)` returning the 3 parts joined by '-'. Write `format_ismn(prefix, publisher, item, check)` returning the 4 parts joined by '-'. Write `format_isan(root, ep, ver)` returning the 3 parts joined by '-'. Provide a `main()` that invokes each function.

title: Cron Expression Builder
spec: Implement a script to construct crontab file lines. Write 8 functions: `cron_time(minute, hour, dom, month, dow)` returning the 5 time fields joined by a space ' '. Write `cron_env(key, value)` returning the key and value joined by '='. Write `cron_job(time_str, user, command)` returning the time, user, and command joined by a space ' '. Write `cron_redirect(command, log_file)` returning the command and log file joined by ' > '. Write `cron_append(command, log_file)` returning the command and log file joined by ' >> '. Write `cron_mailto(email)` returning `['MAILTO', email]` joined by '='. Write `cron_path(paths_str)` returning `['PATH', paths_str]` joined by '='. Write `cron_shell(shell_bin)` returning `['SHELL', shell_bin]` joined by '='. Write a `main()` to generate a realistic crontab.

title: Markdown Table and Link Generator
spec: Write a module to generate Markdown formatting. Implement 8 functions: `table_header(col1, col2, col3)` returning the sequence `['', col1, col2, col3, '']` joined by '|'. Implement `table_separator()` returning the sequence `['', '---', '---', '---', '']` joined by '|'. Implement `table_row(val1, val2, val3)` returning the sequence `['', val1, val2, val3, '']` joined by '|'. Implement `image_link(alt_text, url)` returning the sequence `['![', alt_text, '](', url, ')']` joined by an empty string ''. Implement `hyperlink(text, url)` returning the sequence `['[', text, '](', url, ')']` joined by an empty string ''. Implement `bold_text(text)` returning `['**', text, '**']` joined by an empty string ''. Implement `italic_text(text)` returning `['_', text, '_']` joined by an empty string ''. Implement `inline_code(text)` returning `['`', text, '`']` joined by an empty string ''. Include a `main()` function.

title: Geo-Coordinate String Formatter
spec: Create a tool to format geographical coordinates into standard string representations. Write 8 functions: `point_wkt(lon, lat)` returning the sequence `['POINT(', lon, ' ', lat, ')']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `lat_lon_comma(lat, lon)` returning them joined by ','. Write `bbox_str(min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat)` returning the 4 values joined by ','. Write `geo_uri(lat, lon)` returning the sequence `['geo:', lat, ',', lon]` joined by an empty string ''. Write `tile_url(z, x, y)` returning the 3 zoom/coordinate parts joined by '/'. Write `linestring_wkt(pt1, pt2, pt3)` returning `['LINESTRING(', pt1, ',', pt2, ',', pt3, ')']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `polygon_wkt(pts_str)` returning `['POLYGON((', pts_str, '))']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `mgrs_str(zone, band, square, easting, northing)` returning the 5 parts joined by an empty string ''. Add a `main()`.

title: Prometheus Metric String Builder
spec: Implement a module to build text-based Prometheus metrics. Write 8 functions: `metric_help(name, help_text)` returning `['# HELP', name, help_text]` joined by a space ' '. Write `metric_type(name, type_str)` returning `['# TYPE', name, type_str]` joined by a space ' '. Write `metric_value(name, value)` returning the name and value joined by a space. Write `metric_labeled(name, labels, value)` returning the sequence `[name, '{', labels, '} ', value]` joined by an empty string ''. Write `label_pair(key, value)` returning the sequence `[key, '="', value, '"']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `labels_list(l1, l2, l3)` returning the 3 label strings joined by ','. Write `metric_timestamp(metric_str, ts)` returning them joined by a space ' '. Write `metric_comment(text)` returning `['#', text]` joined by a space ' '. Provide a `main()` to test them.

title: LDAP Distinguished Name Builder
spec: Create a script for building LDAP Distinguished Names (DNs). Write 8 functions: `build_cn(name)` returning 'CN' and the name joined by '='. Write `build_ou(unit)` returning 'OU' and the unit joined by '='. Write `build_dc(domain)` returning 'DC' and the domain joined by '='. Write `build_o(org)` returning 'O' and the org joined by '='. Write `build_c(country)` returning 'C' and the country joined by '='. Write `build_uid(uid)` returning 'UID' and the uid joined by '='. Write `build_dn_2(part1, part2)` returning the two parts joined by ','. Write `build_dn_3(part1, part2, part3)` returning the three parts joined by ','. Include a `main()` function to compose a full DN.

title: LaTeX Math String Formatter
spec: Implement a generator for basic LaTeX math strings. Write 8 functions: `latex_frac(num, den)` returning the sequence `['\\frac{', num, '}{', den, '}']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `latex_super(base, exp)` returning the sequence `[base, '^{', exp, '}']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `latex_sub(base, sub)` returning the sequence `[base, '_{', sub, '}']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `latex_int(lower, upper, expr)` returning the sequence `['\\int_{', lower, '}^{', upper, '} ', expr]` joined by an empty string ''. Write `latex_sum(lower, upper, expr)` returning the sequence `['\\sum_{', lower, '}^{', upper, '} ', expr]` joined by an empty string ''. Write `latex_sqrt(expr)` returning `['\\sqrt{', expr, '}']` joined by an empty string ''. Write `latex_limit(var, val, expr)` returning `['\\lim_{', var, '\\to ', val, '} ', expr]` joined by an empty string ''. Write `latex_vec(name)` returning `['\\vec{', name, '}']` joined by an empty string ''. Write a `main()` function.

title: Network Address Formatter
spec: Create a tool to format network addresses. Write 8 functions: `mac_colon(b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6)` returning the 6 bytes joined by ':'. Write `mac_dash(b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6)` returning the 6 bytes joined by '-'. Write `ipv4_str(o1, o2, o3, o4)` returning the 4 octets joined by '.'. Write `ipv6_subnet(prefix, cidr)` returning the network prefix and cidr joined by '/'. Write `socket_addr(ip, port)` returning the ip and port joined by ':'. Write `url_host(proto, ip, port)` returning the sequence `[proto, '://', ip, ':', port]` joined by an empty string ''. Write `ipsec_spi(src, dst, spi)` returning the three parts joined by '-'. Write `asn_str(asn_prefix, num)` returning them joined by ':'. Include a `main()`.

title: EDI X12 Message Segment Builder
spec: Implement a script to build EDI X12 data segments. Write 8 functions: `isa_segment(sender, receiver, date, time)` returning the sequence `['ISA', sender, receiver, date, time]` joined by '*'. Write `gs_segment(app_sender, app_recv, date, time)` returning `['GS', app_sender, app_recv, date, time]` joined by '*'. Write `st_segment(doc_type, control_num)` returning `['ST', doc_type, control_num]` joined by '*'. Write `se_segment(segments_count, control_num)` returning `['SE', segments_count, control_num]` joined by '*'. Write `iea_segment(groups_count, control_num)` returning `['IEA', groups_count, control_num]` joined by '*'. Write `bht_segment(struct_code, trans_code, ref_id)` returning `['BHT', struct_code, trans_code, ref_id]` joined by '*'. Write `nm1_segment(entity_id, type_qual, last_name, first_name)` returning `['NM1', entity_id, type_qual, last_name, first_name]` joined by '*'. Write `hl_segment(hl_id, parent_id, level_code)` returning `['HL', hl_id, parent_id, level_code]` joined by '*'. Write a `main()` function.

title: CLI Argument String Builder
spec: Write a module to construct command-line argument strings for subprocesses. Implement 8 functions: `flag_long(name, val)` returning the sequence `['--', name, '=', val]` joined by an empty string ''. Implement `flag_short(name, val)` returning `['-', name, ' ', val]` joined by an empty string ''. Implement `auth_basic(user, pwd)` returning the user and password joined by ':'. Implement `ssh_dest(user, host)` returning the user and host joined by '@'. Implement `scp_path(dest, path)` returning the destination and path joined by ':'. Implement `jvm_prop(key, val)` returning `['-D', key, '=', val]` joined by an empty string ''. Implement `gcc_lib(dir, lib)` returning `['-L', dir, ' -l', lib]` joined by an empty string ''. Implement `curl_header(key, val)` returning `['-H "', key, ': ', val, '"']` joined by an empty string ''. Provide a `main()` testing all builders.

title: Bank Account String Formatter
spec: Create a module to format bank account identifiers. Write 8 functions: `iban_format(cc, check, bban)` returning the three parts joined by an empty string ''. Write `bban_format(bank, branch, acc)` returning the three parts joined by an empty string ''. Write `sort_code(p1, p2, p3)` returning the three parts joined by '-'. Write `swift_bic(bank, country, loc, branch)` returning the four parts joined by an empty string ''. Write `routing_acc(routing, acc)` returning the two numbers joined by ':'. Write `card_num(g1, g2, g3, g4)` returning the four groups joined by a space ' '. Write `expiry_date(month, year)` returning them joined by '/'. Write `check_routing(transit, inst, acc)` returning the three parts joined by '-'. Include a `main()` function verifying the outputs.

title: FFMPEG Filter Graph Builder
spec: Implement a script to build FFMPEG filter strings. Write 8 functions: `scale_filter(w, h)` returning the width and height joined by ':'. Write `crop_filter(w, h, x, y)` returning the four parts joined by ':'. Write `pad_filter(w, h, x, y, color)` returning the five parts joined by ':'. Write `fps_filter(fps)` returning 'fps' and the fps value joined by '='. Write `drawtext_filter(font, text, x, y)` returning the sequence `['fontfile=', font, ':text=', text, ':x=', x, ':y=', y]` joined by an empty string ''. Write `overlay_filter(x, y)` returning the sequence `['overlay=', x, ':', y]` joined by an empty string ''. Write `volume_filter(vol)` returning 'volume' and vol joined by '='. Write `rotate_filter(angle)` returning 'rotate' and angle joined by '='. Provide a `main()`.

title: Chess PGN Move Formatter
spec: Create a module to format Portable Game Notation (PGN) chess moves. Write 8 functions: `move_basic(piece, square)` returning the piece and square joined by an empty string ''. Write `move_capture(piece, square)` returning the piece and square joined by 'x'. Write `move_check(move_str)` returning the move_str and '+' joined by an empty string ''. Write `move_mate(move_str)` returning the move_str and '#' joined by an empty string ''. Write `move_promotion(move_str, piece)` returning the move_str and piece joined by '='. Write `game_result(white_score, black_score)` returning the scores joined by '-'. Write `nag_annotation(move_str, nag)` returning the move_str and nag joined by ' '. Write `castling_kingside(symbol1, symbol2)` returning them joined by '-'. Add a `main()` to print sample strings.

title: Financial Trade Message Builder
spec: Write a tool to build financial trade strings. Write 8 functions: `ticker_sym(exch, sym)` returning the exchange and symbol joined by ':'. Write `options_sym(sym, date, type_str, strike)` returning the four parts joined by '-'. Write `order_fix_msg(side, qty, sym, price)` returning the four parts joined by '|'. Write `trade_exec(id_str, sym, qty, price)` returning the four parts joined by ','. Write `cancel_req(orig_id, sym)` returning the original ID and symbol joined by ':'. Write `fill_report(exec_id, qty, price)` returning the three parts joined by ';'. Write `alloc_msg(acc, qty, price)` returning the three parts joined by '/'. Write `quote_req(sym, bid, ask)` returning the three parts joined by '-'. Include a `main()` function outputting a mock trade sequence.

title: AWS Resource ARN Builder
spec: Write a module with functions to generate various AWS ARN strings. Include `build_s3_bucket_arn(partition, bucket_name)`, `build_s3_object_arn(partition, bucket_name, object_key)`, `build_iam_user_arn(partition, account, username)`, `build_iam_role_arn(partition, account, role_name)`, and `build_lambda_arn(partition, region, account, function_name)`. Each ARN consists of fixed segments separated by colons (e.g., `arn:aws:s3:::my_bucket`, `arn:aws:iam::1234:user/bob`). Use string joining on a list of these segments to form the final ARN. Also include a driver function `generate_sample_arns()` that returns a dictionary of these formatted strings.

title: MQTT Topic Name Builder
spec: Create an MQTT topic builder for an IoT platform. Define functions to construct topics for different message types: `get_telemetry_topic(tenant, device_id)`, `get_command_topic(tenant, device_id, command_name)`, `get_status_topic(tenant, device_id)`, and `get_alert_topic(tenant, device_id, severity)`. Topics are built by joining components with slashes (e.g., `tenant1/device2/telemetry`). Also create a `get_wildcard_topic(tenant, device_id)` which ends with `#`. Write a main function that instantiates a set of topics for a device.

title: SIP URI Generator
spec: Implement a module to build SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) URIs. Include functions like `build_basic_sip_uri(user, domain)`, `build_secure_sip_uri(user, domain)`, `build_sip_uri_with_port(user, domain, port)`, `build_sip_uri_with_transport(user, domain, transport)` and `build_full_sip_uri(user, domain, port, transport)`. These functions must assemble parts like the scheme (`sip` or `sips`), user, domain, port, and parameters, using separators like colons, at-signs, and semicolons (e.g., `sips:alice@example.com:5061;transport=tcp`).

title: StatsD Metric Formatter
spec: Write a module to format StatsD metric strings. Provide separate functions: `format_counter(metric, value)`, `format_gauge(metric, value)`, `format_timer(metric, value)`, `format_set(metric, value)`, and `format_histogram(metric, value)`. Each metric string is composed of the metric name, a colon, the value, a pipe character, and the metric type (e.g., `c`, `g`, `ms`). Example output: `users.login:1|c`. Assume all inputs are pre-validated strings and assemble the final metric by joining the pieces.

title: Ical Event Line Builder
spec: Create a generator for individual iCalendar (RFC 5545) property lines. Implement functions for `build_dtstart(date_string, tzid)`, `build_dtend(date_string, tzid)`, `build_organizer(email, cn)`, `build_attendee(email, partstat)`, and `build_summary(text)`. Assemble the property name, parameters (separated by semicolons), and the value (separated by a colon). Example outputs: `DTSTART;TZID=America/New_York:20201010T100000` or `ORGANIZER;CN=John Doe:mailto:john@example.com`.

title: SVG Path Command Generator
spec: Create a library to generate SVG path `d` attribute commands. Write functions `move_to(x, y)`, `line_to(x, y)`, `cubic_bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y)`, `quad_bezier(x1, y1, x, y)`, and `arc_to(rx, ry, rot, large, sweep, x, y)`. Each function should return a single command string by joining the command letter (M, L, C, Q, A) and its numeric arguments with spaces. Example: `arc_to('10', '10', '0', '0', '1', '50', '50')` produces `A 10 10 0 0 1 50 50`.

title: OData Query Builder
spec: Write an OData v4 URL query string builder. Create functions `build_select(fields_string)`, `build_filter_eq(field, value)`, `build_expand(entity)`, `build_orderby(field, direction)`, and `build_top(n)`. Construct query options by joining the operator and arguments, like `$select=Name,Age` or `$filter=Category eq 'Shoes'`. Provide a main driver that calls these functions to build a list of options, then joins them with `&` to simulate a full query string.

title: JMX ObjectName Generator
spec: Implement a Java Management Extensions (JMX) ObjectName builder. Functions should include `build_memory_mbean(pool_name)`, `build_gc_mbean(gc_name)`, `build_thread_mbean()`, `build_os_mbean()`, and `build_custom_mbean(domain, prop_key, prop_val)`. ObjectNames consist of a domain and properties joined by specific characters, e.g., `java.lang:type=MemoryPool,name=Metaspace`. Use joining to combine the domain, colon, and the key-value pairs.

title: Product SKU Generator
spec: Develop a module for generating internal product SKUs. Implement functions for different categories: `generate_electronics_sku(brand, model, color)`, `generate_apparel_sku(gender, type, size, color)`, `generate_food_sku(category, weight, expiration)`, `generate_furniture_sku(type, material, dimensions)`, and `generate_book_sku(publisher, format, genre)`. SKUs are created by joining the uppercase string arguments with hyphens (e.g., `SONY-X900H-BLK`).

title: Redis Connection URI Builder
spec: Implement a module to construct Redis Connection URIs. Include functions `build_standalone_uri(host, port, db)`, `build_authenticated_uri(user, password, host, port, db)`, `build_tls_uri(host, port, db)`, `build_unix_socket_uri(path, db)`, and `build_sentinel_uri(host, port, master_name)`. The URIs must be built by joining schemes (`redis://` or `rediss://`), credentials, hostnames, ports, and database indices with appropriate delimiters like colons, at-signs, and slashes.

title: ZPL Barcode Command Builder
spec: Create a generator for Zebra Programming Language (ZPL) commands used in label printing. Write functions `build_start_format()`, `build_end_format()`, `build_text_field(x, y, font, text)`, `build_barcode_field(x, y, data)`, and `build_qr_code(x, y, data)`. ZPL commands use carets and commas to combine elements, e.g., `^FO50,50^A0N,25,25^FDHello^FS`. Build these strings by joining the respective ZPL tags and position/data arguments.

title: Credit Card Track Data Formatter
spec: Build a formatter for magnetic stripe credit card track data. Provide functions: `format_track1(pan, name, exp_date, svc_code)`, `format_track2(pan, exp_date, svc_code)`, `format_track3(pan, use_limit, restrict_code)`, and `format_cvv2_request(pan, exp_date, cvv)`. Track 1, for example, looks like `%B12345678^DOE/JOHN^2412101?`. Assemble the sentinels, delimiters (like `^` or `=`), and data fields by joining them sequentially.

title: Terraform Resource Block Builder
spec: Write a module to generate simple Terraform resource blocks as one-line configuration strings (for simplified parsing). Provide functions: `build_provider_block(name, region)`, `build_aws_instance(name, ami, type)`, `build_aws_s3_bucket(name, bucket_name)`, `build_aws_security_group(name, vpc_id)`, and `build_aws_vpc(name, cidr)`. Construct strings like `resource "aws_instance" "web" { ami = "ami-123" }` by joining the keywords, quotes, and arguments with spaces.

title: Datadog Tag Formatter
spec: Implement a module to build Datadog metric tags. Write functions `get_host_tags(env, hostname)`, `get_service_tags(env, service, version)`, `get_db_tags(env, db_type, db_name)`, `get_custom_metric_tags(app, feature, status)`, and `get_aws_tags(region, instance_id)`. Each function should return a single string where key-value pairs are joined with colons, and multiple tags are joined with commas (e.g., `env:production,service:billing,version:1.0`).

title: Airline Boarding Pass BCBP Formatter
spec: Generate IATA Bar Coded Boarding Pass (BCBP) strings. Write functions `build_passenger_name(last, first)`, `build_flight_info(pnr, origin, dest, carrier, flt_num, date, seat)`, `build_security_data(seq_num, status)`, `build_version_header()`, and `build_full_bcbp(name, flight, security)`. Assemble the fixed-width continuous string by joining the exact padded components. Example sequence joined: `M1DOE/JOHN            E12345...`.

title: GraphQL Mutation String Builder
spec: Create a simple GraphQL mutation generator. Include functions `create_user_mutation(name, email)`, `update_password_mutation(id, new_pass)`, `delete_user_mutation(id)`, `add_product_mutation(title, price)`, and `checkout_mutation(cart_id)`. Each function builds a string like `mutation { createUser(name: "Alice", email: "a@a.com") { id } }` by joining the fixed mutation shell and the provided argument strings with spaces and curly braces.

title: Vimscript Mapping Builder
spec: Create a utility to construct Vimscript mapping commands. Include functions `build_normal_map(key, command)`, `build_insert_map(key, command)`, `build_visual_map(key, command)`, `build_leader_map(key, command)`, and `build_plugin_map(plugin, command)`. Each function should return a complete mapping line by joining the mapping type (like `nnoremap`), the trigger key, and the command string with spaces (e.g., `nnoremap <C-p> :Telescope<CR>`).

title: G-Code Command Builder
spec: Implement a G-code generator for a CNC machine. Provide functions `linear_move(x, y, z, f)`, `rapid_move(x, y, z)`, `set_spindle_speed(s)`, `tool_change(t)`, and `dwell(p)`. Each command joins a letter (like G, X, Y, Z, F) with its numeric value, and then joins all the terms for that command with spaces, e.g., `G1 X10.5 Y20.0 Z-5.0 F120`. Include a main routine to generate a simple sequence of these joined strings.

title: BIND DNS Record Builder
spec: Create a utility to construct BIND DNS zone file records. Include functions `build_soa_record(domain, ns, email, serial)`, `build_a_record(name, ttl, ip)`, `build_mx_record(name, ttl, pref, exchange)`, `build_cname_record(name, ttl, alias)`, and `build_txt_record(name, ttl, text)`. Each function should join the domain/name, TTL, record class (`IN`), record type, and value with spaces. Example: `example.com. 3600 IN A 192.0.2.1`.

title: RabbitMQ AMQP Routing Key Builder
spec: Develop a module to build routing keys for a topic exchange in RabbitMQ. Functions should include `build_user_event_key(action, user_id)`, `build_order_event_key(status, order_id)`, `build_payment_event_key(provider, status, tx_id)`, `build_notification_key(channel, priority)`, and `build_system_log_key(component, level)`. Routing keys are constructed by joining the distinct semantic words with dots, e.g., `user.created.4512` or `order.shipped.9942`.

title: Lucene Query Builder
spec: Write a generator for Apache Lucene search queries. Implement functions `build_term_query(field, term)`, `build_wildcard_query(field, pattern)`, `build_fuzzy_query(field, term, distance)`, `build_range_query(field, start, end)`, and `build_boosted_query(query, boost_factor)`. Construct the queries by joining the field name, a colon, and the search term/pattern (e.g., `title:lucene` or `date:[20020101 TO 20030101]`).

title: Maven POM Dependency Builder
spec: Create a script to generate Maven POM XML snippets. Write functions `build_dependency_block(group, artifact, version)`, `build_plugin_block(group, artifact, version)`, `build_property_block(key, value)`, `build_repository_block(id, url)`, and `build_exclusion_block(group, artifact)`. Construct the single-line XML tags by joining the opening tag, the inner text value, and the closing tag (e.g., `<groupId>org.example</groupId>`).

title: HAProxy ACL Rule Builder
spec: Create a generator for HAProxy ACL configuration lines. Provide functions `build_path_beg_acl(name, path)`, `build_hdr_sub_acl(name, header, value)`, `build_src_ip_acl(name, ip)`, `build_use_backend_rule(backend, acl_name)`, and `build_http_request_deny(acl_name)`. Configuration rules are constructed by joining tokens with spaces, e.g., `acl is_api path_beg /api` or `use_backend api_servers if is_api`.

title: SSH Config File Builder
spec: Create an SSH client `config` snippet generator. Write functions `build_host_header(alias)`, `build_hostname_directive(address)`, `build_user_directive(user)`, `build_port_directive(port)`, and `build_identity_file_directive(path)`. Directives are formed by joining the directive name (like `HostName` or `User`) and the value with a space. Include a driver that generates these lines for a specific server alias.

title: Zookeeper Path Builder
spec: Write a module for generating Apache ZooKeeper node paths. Provide functions `build_service_registration_path(service_name, instance_id)`, `build_leader_election_path(cluster_name)`, `build_config_path(app_name, env)`, `build_lock_path(resource_name)`, and `build_worker_task_path(worker_id, task_id)`. Paths must begin with a slash and are built by joining the hierarchical string components with slashes (e.g., `/services/billing/node-1`).

title: NMEA 0183 GPS Sentence Builder
spec: Write a module with functions to format standard NMEA 0183 sentences from string arguments. Include 8 distinct functions for different sentences: build_gpgga(time, lat, lat_dir, lon, lon_dir, fix, sats, alt), build_gprmc(time, status, lat, lat_dir, lon, lon_dir, speed, angle, date), build_gpvtg(course_true, course_mag, speed_knots, speed_kph), build_gpgsa(mode1, mode2, sat1, sat2, sat3, pdop, hdop, vdop), build_gpgsv(msg_count, msg_num, sats, sat_info), build_gpgll(lat, lat_dir, lon, lon_dir, time, status), build_gpzda(time, day, month, year, tz_hh, tz_mm), and build_gptxt(id, msg_num, msg_type, text). Each function must return the comma-separated sentence string starting with the sentence type. Example: build_gpvtg("054.7", "034.4", "005.5", "010.2") returns "$GPVTG,054.7,T,034.4,M,005.5,N,010.2,K". Do not calculate checksums.

title: QR Code Payload Builder
spec: Create a module to generate raw payload strings for QR codes across 8 different data types. Implement functions taking string arguments: vcard_name_line(last, first, middle), mecard_payload(name, phone, email), wifi_payload(ssid, password, enc_type, hidden), sms_payload(phone, body), mailto_payload(email, sub, body), geo_payload(lat, lon, alt), event_payload(title, start, end, loc), and phone_payload(number). Each function must construct the standardized format combining parts with specific separators. Examples: wifi_payload("MyNet", "pass", "WPA", "false") joins the key-value pairs with semicolons to return "WIFI:S:MyNet;T:WPA;P:pass;H:false;;". geo_payload("40.7", "-74.0", "10") uses commas to return "geo:40.7,-74.0,10".

title: CEF (Common Event Format) String Generator
spec: Write a script to build ArcSight CEF strings for 8 different security event categories. Implement functions taking string parameters: build_auth(time, user, src, outcome), build_fw(src, dst, sport, dport, act), build_ids(sig_id, name, sev, src), build_av(file, hash, status, user), build_dlp(file, rule, act, user), build_vpn(user, src, dur, bytes), build_waf(url, method, attack, act), and build_audit(user, act, res, status). Each string must start with "CEF:0|Vendor|Product|Version|" followed by pipe-separated event fields specific to the function. Example: build_fw("10.0.0.1", "8.8.8.8", "54321", "53", "DROP") combines these into a single pipe-separated string including the standard prefix.

title: HTTP/1.1 Raw Request Builder
spec:
Write a module to generate raw HTTP/1.1 request strings. Implement 8 functions accepting string parameters: get_req(path, host), post_req(path, host, type, len, body), put_req(path, host, type, len, body), delete_req(path, host), head_req(path, host), options_req(path, host), patch_req(path, host, type, len, body), and trace_req(path, host). Each function must return the exact HTTP request string, separating the request line, headers, and body with carriage return and line feed (
), and ending with a blank line if there's no body. Example: get_req("/index.html", "example.com") assembles the method, path, protocol, and Host header, joined by 
, ending with a double 
.

title: ANSI Terminal Escape Sequence Builder
spec: Develop a module to build complex ANSI escape sequence strings for terminal UI formatting. Provide 8 functions taking string arguments: rgb_fg(r, g, b, text), rgb_bg(r, g, b, text), cursor_move(row, col), clear_screen(mode), set_title(title), draw_box_chars(tl, tr, bl, br), hyperlink(url, text), and scroll_region(top, bottom). Each function must construct the escape sequence using standard ANSI prefixes (like \033[) and suffixes, joining the numeric parameters with semicolons where appropriate. Example: rgb_fg("255", "0", "0", "Error") combines the color components to build "\033[38;2;255;0;0mError\033[0m". cursor_move("10", "5") builds "\033[10;5H".

title: Tmux Status Line Component Builder
spec: Write a module to format strings for tmux status line segments. Implement 8 functions with string arguments: session_info(name, windows), active_window(index, name, flags), inactive_window(index, name), battery_status(pct, state), cpu_load(avg1, avg5, avg15), memory_usage(used, total), network_speed(rx, tx), and clock_display(date, time, tz). The functions must build tmux-compatible format strings combining text components, variables, and spaces. Example: cpu_load("1.5", "2.0", "1.8") joins the averages with spaces and prepends a label to return "CPU: 1.5 2.0 1.8". clock_display("2023-01-01", "12:00", "UTC") returns "2023-01-01 12:00 UTC".

title: Gstreamer Pipeline Element Builder
spec: Create a script to construct Gstreamer pipeline string segments for 8 different media operations. Implement functions taking string arguments: file_src(location, blocksize), video_scale(w, h, method), x264_enc(bitrate, preset, tune), audio_convert(fmt, rate), mp4_mux(faststart, streamable), udp_sink(host, port, sync), rtp_h264_pay(mtu, pt), and text_overlay(text, val, hal). Each function builds a space-separated string for that element containing the element name and its key=value properties. Example: x264_enc("2048", "medium", "zerolatency") returns "x264enc bitrate=2048 preset=medium tune=zerolatency".

title: W3C Trace Context Header Builder
spec: Write a utility for building OpenTelemetry W3C Trace Context header strings. Implement 8 functions taking string arguments: build_traceparent(version, trace_id, span_id, flags), build_tracestate(vendor, value), add_tracestate_entry(existing, vendor, value), build_b3_single(trace_id, span_id, sampled), build_b3_multi_traceid(trace_id), build_b3_multi_spanid(span_id), build_jaeger(trace_id, span_id, parent, flags), and build_datadog(trace_id, parent, priority). Each constructs a specific HTTP header value using dashes, commas, or colons as separators depending on the format. Example: build_traceparent("00", "4bf92f", "00f067", "01") combines the parts with dashes to return "00-4bf92f-00f067-01".

title: SDP (Session Description Protocol) Line Builder
spec: Create a module to generate raw SDP lines for WebRTC. Write 8 functions accepting string arguments: origin_line(user, sess_id, sess_ver, net_type, addr_type, addr), connection_line(net, addr_type, addr), media_line(type, port, proto, fmt), rtpmap_line(payload, enc, clock, channels), fmtp_line(payload, params), crypto_line(tag, suite, key_params), candidate_line(found, comp, transport, prio, addr, port, type), and bandwidth_line(bw_type, bw). Each constructs the standard string starting with its single letter code (e.g., "o=", "c=", "m=") followed by the space-separated arguments. Example: media_line("audio", "49170", "RTP/AVP", "0") returns "m=audio 49170 RTP/AVP 0".

title: HLS M3U8 Playlist Tag Builder
spec: Develop a module for constructing EXT-X tags for HLS M3U8 playlists. Implement 8 functions using string parameters: ext_inf(duration, title), ext_x_stream_inf(bw, res, codecs, path), ext_x_media(type, group, name, uri), ext_x_key(method, uri, iv), ext_x_map(uri, byterange), ext_x_program_date_time(time_str), ext_x_daterange(id, start, duration), and ext_x_session_data(data_id, value). Each function formats the specific tag, joining multiple attributes with commas where required, or separating the tag and value with a colon. Example: ext_x_stream_inf("500", "1920x1080", "avc1", "h.m3u8") returns "#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:BANDWIDTH=500,RESOLUTION=1920x1080,CODECS=\"avc1\"\nh.m3u8".

title: PKCS#11 URI Builder
spec: Write a utility to construct PKCS#11 URIs identifying cryptographic tokens and objects. Implement 8 functions with string parameters: token_uri(model, mfg, serial, label), object_uri(token, obj, type, cls), key_uri(token, id, type), cert_uri(token, issuer, serial), slot_uri(slot_id, slot_desc), module_uri(name, path), pin_uri(token, source), and full_uri(model, serial, obj, id). Each function formats the "pkcs11:" URI schema by appending the provided key-value attribute strings combined with semicolons. Example: object_uri("MyToken", "MyKey", "private", "key") combines the parts to return "pkcs11:token=MyToken;object=MyKey;type=private;object-type=key".

title: YARA Rule Generator
spec: Create a module to generate different textual blocks of a YARA rule. Implement 8 functions taking string parameters: rule_header(name, tag1, tag2), meta_author(name, date), meta_desc(desc, version), string_hex(var_name, hex_bytes), string_text(var_name, text, modifiers), condition_all_of(var1, var2, var3), condition_filesize(min_kb, max_kb), and condition_pe_section(sec_name, sec_size). Each constructs the correct syntax using spaces or commas. Examples: string_hex("$hex1", "4D 5A") returns "$hex1 = { 4D 5A }". condition_all_of("$s1", "$s2", "$s3") combines the variables to return "all of ($s1, $s2, $s3)".

title: Systemd Unit File Line Builder
spec: Write a module to format common configuration lines for systemd service unit files. Implement 8 functions with string arguments: unit_desc(desc, doc_url), unit_after(srv1, srv2, srv3), service_exec(cmd, arg1, arg2), service_restart(policy, sec), service_env(key, val), service_user_group(user, group), install_wanted(target), and timer_cal(spec). Each function returns the configuration line by combining the key, an equals sign, and the space-separated values. Examples: service_exec("/bin/py", "-u", "main.py") returns "ExecStart=/bin/py -u main.py". unit_after("net.target", "syslog.target", "local.target") returns "After=net.target syslog.target local.target".

title: IPsec IKEv2 Proposal Builder
spec: Create a utility to construct IKEv2 proposal strings for strongSwan configurations. Write 8 functions accepting string arguments: encrypt_alg(alg, key_len), integ_alg(alg), dh_group(group), prf_alg(alg), full_proposal(enc, integ, prf, dh), esp_proposal(enc, integ, dh), ah_proposal(integ, dh), and ike_sa_proposal(enc, prf, dh). The proposal functions must assemble the configuration strings using dashes as separators. Example: full_proposal("aes256", "sha384", "prfsha384", "modp3072") combines the four segments to return "aes256-sha384-prfsha384-modp3072". ike_sa_proposal("aes128", "prfsha256", "modp2048") returns "aes128-prfsha256-modp2048".

title: IMAP Command Formatter
spec: Write a script to format raw IMAP4rev1 client commands from string arguments. Implement 8 distinct functions: login_cmd(tag, user, password), select_cmd(tag, mailbox), fetch_cmd(tag, seq, items), store_cmd(tag, seq, flag_op, flags), copy_cmd(tag, seq, mailbox), search_cmd(tag, criteria), append_cmd(tag, mailbox, flags, date, size), and uid_fetch_cmd(tag, seq, items). Each function constructs a space-separated IMAP command string. Example: fetch_cmd("A03", "1:5", "(FLAGS BODY.PEEK[])") joins the arguments with spaces to return "A03 FETCH 1:5 (FLAGS BODY.PEEK[])". login_cmd("A01", "user", "pass123") returns "A01 LOGIN user pass123".

title: CMake Command Builder
spec: Develop a module to generate lines of CMake script from string arguments. Write 8 functions: cmake_min(version), proj_decl(name, version, langs), add_exec(name, src1, src2, src3), add_lib(name, type, src1, src2), target_link(name, scope, lib1, lib2), target_inc(name, scope, dir1, dir2), set_prop(target, prop, val), and find_pkg(name, version, req). Each combines the command name and arguments into the standard format, joining multiple sources or libraries with spaces. Example: target_link("myapp", "PRIVATE", "libA", "libB") returns "target_link_libraries(myapp PRIVATE libA libB)". add_lib("mylib", "SHARED", "a.c", "b.c") returns "add_library(mylib SHARED a.c b.c)".

title: BGP Community String Builder
spec: Create a module to format BGP community attribute strings. Implement 8 functions taking string arguments: std_community(asn, val), ext_route_target(asn, val), ext_route_origin(asn, val), large_community(asn, local_data1, local_data2), link_bw(asn, bw), soo(asn, val), ipv6_ext(ipv6, val), and well_known(name). These functions must construct the standard colon-separated string formats. Example: large_community("65000", "100", "200") combines the three parts with colons to return "65000:100:200". ext_route_target("65001", "300") returns "rt:65001:300". ipv6_ext("2001:db8::1", "123") returns "2001:db8::1:123".

title: InfluxDB Line Protocol Builder
spec: Write a script to build data points in InfluxDB Line Protocol format using string arguments. Provide 8 functions: point_int(meas, tag_k, tag_v, field_k, field_v, ts), point_float(meas, tag_k, tag_v, field_k, field_v, ts), point_string(meas, tag_k, tag_v, field_k, field_v, ts), point_boolean(meas, tag_k, tag_v, field_k, field_v, ts), point_two_tags(meas, t1_k, t1_v, t2_k, t2_v, f_k, f_v, ts), point_two_fields(meas, t_k, t_v, f1_k, f1_v, f2_k, f2_v, ts), point_no_tags(meas, f_k, f_v, ts), and point_no_ts(meas, t_k, t_v, f_k, f_v). Each builds the protocol string combining the measurement, tags (comma-separated), fields (comma-separated), and timestamp (space-separated). Example: point_int("cpu", "host", "serverA", "usage", "85", "164099") returns "cpu,host=serverA usage=85i 164099".

title: JWT String Formatter (Base64 Structure)
spec: Create a module that builds the basic structure of JSON Web Tokens and authorization headers using string arguments. Implement 8 functions: build_access_token(hdr, payload, sig), build_refresh_token(hdr, payload, sig), build_id_token(hdr, payload, sig), build_unsigned_token(hdr, payload), auth_bearer_header(token), auth_basic_header(user, pass), dpop_proof_header(token), and oauth_token_response(access, type, expires, refresh). Token builder functions must combine the parts with dots. Header functions combine prefix and token with a space. Example: build_access_token("eyJhbG", "eyJzdW", "SflKxw") combines the segments to return "eyJhbG.eyJzdW.SflKxw".

title: Varnish VCL Subroutine Builder
spec: Write a module to generate common blocks for a Varnish VCL file. Provide 8 functions using string parameters: vcl_backend(name, host, port), acl_block(name, ip1, ip2, ip3), set_req_hdr(hdr, val), unset_req_hdr(hdr), set_beresp_ttl(ttl), return_action(action), synth_resp(status, reason, body), and add_resp_hdr(hdr, val). Each generates a single configuration line or block string. Examples: acl_block("local", "127.0.0.1", "10.0.0.1", "192.168.1.1") joins the IPs with formatting into an ACL block. set_req_hdr("X-Forwarded-For", "client.ip") returns "set req.http.X-Forwarded-For = client.ip;".

title: SNort/Suricata Rule Builder
spec: Develop a module to format Suricata / Snort Intrusion Detection System (IDS) rules. Implement 8 functions taking string parameters: alert_tcp(src, sport, dst, dport, msg, sid), alert_udp(src, sport, dst, dport, msg, sid), alert_icmp(src, dst, msg, sid), alert_http(src, dst, msg, sid), rule_flow(direction, state), rule_content(content, nocase), rule_pcre(regex), and drop_ip(src, dst, msg, sid). Each function constructs a space-separated rule string using standard IDS syntax. Example: alert_tcp("$HOME_NET", "any", "$EXTERNAL_NET", "80", "HTTP Traffic", "1000001") returns "alert tcp $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET 80 (msg:\"HTTP Traffic\"; sid:1000001;)".

title: X11 Window Geometry and State String Builder
spec: Create a utility to build string identifiers for X11 / Wayland window manager properties. Write 8 functions accepting string arguments: geom_absolute(w, h, x, y), geom_relative(w, h, x_pct, y_pct), win_title(class_name, instance, title), win_state(max_v, max_h, hidden), win_motif(decor, func, input), win_pid_machine(pid, hostname), xrandr_out(name, mode, rate, pos), and xprop_atom(name, type, val). Each formats these parameters into a specific standard string using plus, cross, or dot separators. Example: geom_absolute("800", "600", "100", "50") combines the values to return "800x600+100+50". win_title("URxvt", "urxvt", "Terminal") returns "URxvt.urxvt.Terminal".

title: BIP32 / BIP44 Derivation Path Builder
spec: Write a module to construct BIP44 derivation paths for HD wallets given string arguments. Implement 8 functions for different cryptocurrencies: path_bitcoin(account, change, index), path_ethereum(account, index), path_litecoin(account, change, index), path_dogecoin(account, change, index), path_ripple(account, index), path_cardano(account, change, index), path_solana(account, index), and path_custom(coin_type, account, change, index). The functions must build the standard "m/purpose'/coin_type'/account'/change/index" paths by combining the segments with slashes. Example: path_bitcoin("0", "1", "5") builds "m/44'/0'/0'/1/5". path_ethereum("0", "0") builds "m/44'/60'/0'/0/0".

title: MIDI SysEx Message Builder
spec: Develop a utility to build text hex representations of MIDI messages. Write 8 functions accepting string hex values: note_on(ch, note, vel), note_off(ch, note, vel), control_change(ch, cc, val), program_change(ch, prog), pitch_bend(ch, lsb, msb), channel_pressure(ch, val), poly_pressure(ch, note, val), and sysex_msg(mfg, p1, p2, p3). The functions return a space-separated string of the hex bytes. Example: note_on("90", "3C", "7F") joins the strings to return "90 3C 7F". sysex_msg("41", "10", "42", "12") prepends F0 and appends F7, returning "F0 41 10 42 12 F7".

title: Minecraft RCON Command Builder
spec: Create a module to generate RCON server administration commands for a Minecraft server. Implement 8 functions accepting string arguments: give_item(player, item, count), tp_player(player, x, y, z), time_set(time_val), weather_set(type, duration), ban_player(player, reason, duration), kick_player(player, reason), title_show(player, title_text, subtitle_text), and xp_add(player, amount, levels). Each function formats the exact space-separated command string required by the console. Example: give_item("Notch", "minecraft:diamond", "64") combines the parts to return "give Notch minecraft:diamond 64". tp_player("Steve", "100", "50", "-200") returns "tp Steve 100 50 -200".
